_note: Reference objects for measuring a pothole in a photo (civil/measure.py). Only exact, standard sizes: width is the short side, length the long side, in metres.

refs.label: ID card or bank card
refs.standard: ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1, 85.60 x 53.98 mm (Thai ID card, bank cards)

refs.label: Ruler or tape (2 points)
refs.standard: a known length between two marks
refs.note: Only for a photo taken straight down at the hole: two points give a scale but no perspective.
